failed_check: project archive import navigation after download
cause: Playwright setInputFiles does not wait for a disabled file input; export refresh was still in progress and the guarded action did not send an import request. Local artifact writes hid the timing window.
fix: Explicitly gate the export refresh, assert import input disabled while refresh is pending, release it, wait for input enabled and require import response HTTP201; also wait for input enabled before malformed-archive check.
